why: Place tab's ordinary market scene of stalls selling reagents to buyers, unmarked, beside CRISIS Under Siege and Famine ('nothing comes in by road'; market has only city's own people)
Apothecary row (no mark) says a shop leans to 'imported medicines'; CRISIS Under Siege: 'nothing comes in by road, gate or water', and Crisis tab says trade has stopped
Bowyers row (unmarked) 'Supplies the watch, the garrison, and the caravans'; under the siege no caravan comes or goes by road
Daily markets offer 'Fresh produce' with no mark while the Fish market, inns, customs are marked stopped and no cart reaches the city (famine; fields abandoned per C12824)
Criminal services row 'Contraband transport' prints no house line after its description, unlike the other four rows of the group (5); no Institutions row lists this service
Internal Security 'arrested, heard and held ... a hearing, not a beating' (calm scene) against Foundations 'Law & order · Collapsed' and 'garrison keeps order, more harshly' under siege and famine
Magic tab says medical treatment 'leans on help beyond ordinary work' against its own row 'Medical role: absent'; the Relied-upon row names only Spellcasting Services, not medicine
